question: Should this durable review-telemetry and dashboard-health contract be adopted as the compatibility foundation before https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/674 proceeds?
rationale: The patch creates persistent internal API and operational-health semantics intended for a later rollout, so merge approval requires a repository-owner decision about the long-lived contract rather than a narrow mechanical fix.

options.title: Adopt the observation contract
options.body: Approve the contract after confirming existing producers and consumers remain compatible, so the later shard rollout can use it.

options.title: Narrow or defer the contract
options.body: Request a smaller observation surface or defer fields and health semantics until the consuming rollout has a confirmed need.

recommendation.title: Adopt the observation contract
recommendation.body: Approve the contract after confirming existing producers and consumers remain compatible, so the later shard rollout can use it.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context links hxy91819 to both the proposed contract and its intended immediate consumer; independent historical ownership was not available in this review context.
